5.6.36 Rte_IFeedback Purpose: Provide access to acknowledgement notifications for implicit sender receiver communication and to pass error notification to senders. Signature: [SWS_Rte_07367] Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_Rte_00122, SRS_Rte_- 00129, SRS_Rte_00185 ⌈ Std_ReturnType Rte_[Byps_]IFeedback__

_ ( [IN RTE_Instance ]) Where is the short name of the RunnableEntity,

is the short name of the PPortPrototype and the short name of the VariableDataPrototype within the sender-receiver interface categorizing the port. [Byps_] is an optional infix used when com- ponent wrapper method for bypass support is enabled for the related software component type.⌋ Existence: Note: according to [SWS_Rte_01283], acknowledgment is enabled for a provided VariableDataPrototype by the existence of a TransmissionAcknowledgementRequest in the SenderCom- Spec.
